name: Morpho
description: Erosion, dilation, opening, closing, gradient, top-hat and black-hat with a structuring element given as a picture.

inputs.name: structure
inputs.description: Structuring element: its pixels above 0 are part of it, centred on pixel ((w - 1) / 2, (h - 1) / 2); up to 63x63 is read

params.name: planes
params.description: Channels to filter, FFmpeg's bits on gbrp: 1 green, 2 blue, 4 red
